Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

IS: 6404 -1971 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

TWEEZERS, DENTAL, NO. 1, 2 AND 3 



( Reaffirmed 2000 ) 



c 

3 

u 



1. Scope — Dimensions and other requirements for dental tweezers No. 1, 2 and 3. 
2- Shapes and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1 to 3. 

2.1 Joint— Block joint or semi-block joint as in 5 of Section 2 of IS : 3642-1966 'General require- 
ments for surgical instruments \ 

2.2 Serrations of Tweezers No. 3 — Transverse, that is, perpendicular to the axis of the jaw, 

3. IVIaterials 

Component Material Conforming to 

Stainless steel 



Arms 



Guide pin and rivets, 
if used 



Stainless steel 



Designation 22Cr13 or 30Cr13 
of Schedule V of IS : 1570-1961 
' Schedules for wrought steels 
for general engineering purposes ' 

Designation 22Cr13, 30Cr13 or 
22Cr18Ni2 of Schedule V of 
IS: 1570-1961 



4. Workmanship and Finish 



4.1 The tweezers shall be symmetrical. On closure of the arms the tips or the serrations shall meet 
accurately and the engagement shall commence at the extreme end and progress along the entire length 
of the tip. On pressing the arms further, the tips shall have no tendency to gape. 

4.2 The guide pin on one arm shall be a sliding fit in the corresponding hole in the opposite arm and 
shall not protrude beyond the guide hole when the tips are fully engaged. 

4.3 There shall be no side play on the arms. 

4.4 The arms shall be finished smooth, free from burrs, pits, cracks and other surface defects and shall 
not have sharp edges. 

4.5 The serrations of tweezers No. 3 shall be clean. 

4.6 The tweezers shall be suitably passivated and polished bright. 

5. Heat Treatment — The tweezers shall be uniformly hardened and tempered to 370 to 410 W. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Practical Test— The tweezers shall be used to pick up one strand at a time of teased cotton wool 
from a polished surface. The tweezers shall do this easily. 

6.2 Flexibility Test — The tweezers shall be tested for flexibility as given in 6.2.1 to 6.2-3. 

6.2.1 The arms of the tweezers shall be made to close to a maximum by manual compression. On 
releaseof the force, no permanent set shall be observed and the tweezers shall satisfy the requirements 
of 4.1. 

6.2.2 The jaws of the tweezers shall be made to close on a piece of firm vulcanized rubber, 3 mm 
thick, and maximum thumb and finger pressure applied on opposite arms 25 mm away from the tips 
of the jaws. On release of the force, the tweezers shall show no sign of damage. 



Adopted 12 November 1971

FIG. 3 TWEEZERS, DENTAL NO. 3 

6,2.3 The joint end of tlie tweezers shall be fixed in a vice so that 135-nnm portion of the tweezers 
protrudes above the surface of the vice. By the application of force at the bend of the jaw, one arnn 
shall be deflected in a plane at right angles to its own by 25 mm as measured at the tip of the jaw. On 
release of the force, no permanent set shall be observed. 

6-3 Corrosion Resistance Test — As given in 8 of IS: 3887-1966 'General requirements for cutting 
type dental instruments '. 

7. Marking — The tweezers shall be legibly and Indelibly marked with their number; the manufacturer's 
name, initials or trade-mark; the letters ' SS '; and the country of manufacture. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available from the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi 1. 

8. Packing — The tips of the tweezers shall be preserved by hot dipping individually In plastlpeel. The 
tweezers shall either be wrapped in wax paper or put in a polyethylene bag, and then packed In cartons 
in accordance with trade practice; or the packing may be done as agreed to between the purchaser and 
the supplier. ^ 



Printed at Delhi Printers, Delhi 6, India
